title: Providing Comprehensive Annual maintenance Contract (CAMC) services for VTS Gulf of Kutch for 01 year from 16.04.2026 to 15.04.2027
summary: E-tender for a one-year comprehensive annual maintenance contract (16.04.2026 to 15.04.2027) covering all VTS Gulf of Kutch equipment - radars, AIS, VHF, microwave links, servers/software, consoles, meteo sensors, RDF, DG sets, UPS, ACs and lightning conductors - at MCC Kandla and 21 other VTS, repeater and port monitoring stations (VTS Directorate, Gandhidham).

money.performance_security: 10% of contract value, FDR/Bank Guarantee, valid 15 months, within 10 days of work order
money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all taxes. EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee from nationalized/RBI approved bank in favour of Dy. Director General, DLL, payable at Gandhidham; original to reach TIA by bid deadline; EMD exemption not allowed (CPPP page). Tender fee Nil. Payment quarterly with job sheets. Penalty 0.02% of contract value per day for non-compliance of restoration timelines (72 h local repair / 7 days spares within India / 60 days imported), capped at 10%. Contract extendable by one year or more at same rates.

eligibility: Bidder must be Original Software Developer (OSD) of VTS software, or have JV/consortium/MOA/AOA with OSD (GST-registered bidder as lead partner)
Bidder or joint partner to have authorization (or service support agreement) from Terma AS, Denmark, OEM of existing radars, for repair and spares support in India

Similar works in last 7 years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; similar work = supply, installation, integration, testing, commissioning and comprehensive maintenance of minimum three radars and minimum one AIS-based VTS system incl. VTS infrastructure; work orders and completion certificates/CRAC on GeM
Average annual turnover not less than Rs 30,00,000 for 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 (CA certificate)
Notarized affidavit on litigation and blacklisting in last 3 years ending 28.02.2026; ITRs for last three years ending 31.03.2025
Solvency certificate from scheduled bank >= 40% of estimated value, not older than 3 months
Tender acceptance letter, undertakings (site/requirement assessment, confidentiality of VTS data) and eligibility compliance sheet (Annexures I-V)
Technical evaluation minimum 60 marks: turnover 10, solvency 5, similar experience 65, performance quality 20
specs: Existing radars: 9 X-band Terma Scanter 2001 (25 kW, 18 ft antenna, dual Tx/Rx, 2011) and 2 S-band Terma Scanter 2001 (30 kW) at Okha and Jakhau
RDF: Servo Corporation of America DF2110M at Okha and Jakhau (2011)
AIS: Kongsberg BS500/BS600/BS410/BS610 base stations at Jakhau, Navinal, Kandla, Okha, Sikka, Chhachhi
Meteo: Vaisala WXT-500 weather stations (2019) at Okha, Vadinar, Sikka, Rozi, Navlakhi PMS and MCC Kandla
VHF: Jotron VoIP radios TA7650/RA-7203 and TR-7750C (25 W, 2020); Jotron JRRC 106 consoles; HP Z4 G4 workstations
Microwave: Ericsson Mini Link 6691/6693/6363 (30 links); 8 links replaced after cyclone Biparjoy (2023) with AirFiber AF-5U
Servers: HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen10 (C-Scope), DL20 Gen10 (VHF), web server; Cisco Catalyst 2960; ATEN CS1308 KVM

VTS software: Kongsberg C-Scope (extractor/tracker, VTS control, AIS, CSLR logger/replay, PMIS); replacement allowed at no extra cost if mature (>3 years in use) and IVEF compliant, with demonstration within 2 days of technical bid opening
DG sets: 160 KVA Kirloskar (MCC Kandla), 125 KVA Sudhir and 62.5 KVA Kirloskar (Navinal), 15-50 KVA at other stations
System availability > 99%; UPS backup minimum 2 hours; magnetrons supplied by department, installation by agency
Detailed VTMS software and MIS feature requirements (3D view, OpenGL, S52/S57/S63, WMS/WMTS, route mesh, IEC 61174, simulator, track warnings, IVEF integration for NCVTS)
notes: Document combines CPPP tender details printout (pages 1-3; page 3 scanned, only creator designation/date) and the 53-page bid document. Bid document dated 21.03.2026 gives download/submission from 21.03.2026 and pre-bid 25.03.2026 15:30, while CPPP page shows publish 23.03.2026 09:00 and pre-bid 15:00. BOQ in PDF has no rates. Section VI lists 22 stations (09 VTS sensor, 03 repeater, 01 MCC, 06 PMS, 03 ICG/Navy terminals). Bid-opener names and personal e-mail IDs on the CPPP printout were not transcribed. Several station names (Kandla, Balachadi, Chudeshwar, Harudi, Vanku, Rozi, Sikka, Vadinar) are not in station list.
